assertions.name: deploy-west_waypoints_fit
assertions.expected: every ground-level route waypoint fits a standing capsule (route matches geometry)

assertions.name: deploy-west_started_on_floor
assertions.expected: feet at y≈0 and grounded (began standing on the switchyard floor)

assertions.name: deploy-west_spawn_fits
assertions.expected: the deploy pad fits a standing capsule (shipping StaticBoxWorld.canFit)

assertions.name: deploy-west_climb_stays_grounded
assertions.expected: 0 airborne ticks during the climb (no free-fall / hop between treads)

assertions.name: deploy-west_reached_deck
assertions.expected: a grounded tick at deck height, past the south parapet

assertions.name: deploy-west_finished_standing_at_objective
assertions.expected: grounded on the deck, feetY≈1.6 m, within 1.2 m of the objective hold
